info.title: roblox-cs
info.description: Transpiles C# to Roblox Luau. Command-line tool: roblox-cs <project.csproj> --out <dir>.

options.name: --out
options.description:
Write one .luau file per .cs file into <dir>, keeping
the folder layout of each input directory or project.
Files whose text did not change are not rewritten.
Without --out, the Luau code is printed to stdout.

options.name: --rojo
options.description:
The Rojo project that maps the output files to Roblox
instances, used to compute requires between files.
With --out, default.project.json is used when it is
next to the input project or directory, or in the
current directory.

options.name: --no-rojo
options.description:
Do not use a Rojo project: requires are relative paths
that mirror the output folder layout.

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
The project configuration (default Debug), as in
dotnet build: selects conditions and defines DEBUG
or RELEASE in SDK projects.

options.name: -p
options.description: Set a project property (also --property:<name>=<value>).

options.name: --define
options.description: Define a preprocessor symbol for every file.

options.name: --source-maps
options.description:
Write <file>.luau.map next to each output, mapping its
lines to the C# lines (see 'roblox-cs map').

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Start every output with --!strict, so Studio and
luau-lsp type-check it in strict mode.

options.name: --nowarn
--runtime-checks
options.description:
Check null receivers and indices in the output and throw
.NET's exceptions. For development: it slows the game.

options.name: --native
options.description:
Start every output with --!native, so Roblox compiles
it to native code ([Native] marks single classes or
methods instead).

options.name: --optimize
options.description: Start every output with --!optimize <level> (0, 1 or 2).

options.name: --runtime-library
options.description:
Write the runtime helpers into one shared module at
<path> (relative to the output directory), which every
output requires. By default, with --out, it is
RuntimeLib.luau in the output, or with a Rojo project
in its first folder in ReplicatedStorage.
--no-runtime-library Declare the helpers in each output that uses them.

options.name: --places
options.description: The place IDs PlaceInterop.GetPlaceId is replaced with.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Transpile again whenever an input changes (needs --out).

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version of roblox-cs.

options.name: --config
options.description: Read options from <file>. By default roblox-cs.json in
